set_module_auto_repr: set module_auto_repr to disable or enable automatic string representation for Haiku modules
set_check_jax_usage: set check_jax_usage to enforce correct JAX transform usage inside Haiku transformed functions
set_rng_reserve_size: set rng_reserve_size to change how many RNG keys are reserved when calling next_rng_key
context_config_override: use config context manager to temporarily override multiple config settings within a code block
with_config_decorator: use with_config decorator to run a function with overridden config settings
